app.title: ALIEN IMPOSTER
app.tagline: Gather friends · share a code · find the infiltrators

menu.hostHint: You'll get a code to text your crew

auth.loginSubtitle: Board the ship. Trust no one.
auth.enterUsername: Enter your username to sign in.
auth.signupSubtitle: Pick a unique username and password
auth.usernameTakenBody: That username is already in use. Try another.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutBody: You will need to log in again to join a party.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, callsign, and game history. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteSureBody: Your account will be gone for good.

gather.title: Gather your crew
gather.body: Get 4–10 friends together. One person hosts and shares a party code — everyone else joins from their own phone.

roles.title: Crew vs. Infiltrators
roles.body: Most of you are loyal Crew. But 1–2 players are secretly Infiltrators. Nobody knows who is who.

missions.title: Play the missions
missions.body: Each round everyone gets a task — a question, a drawing, a vote. Crew all see the same prompt; Infiltrators get a sneaky twist. Answer out loud.

spot.title: Spot the odd one out
spot.body: Crew: watch for answers that don't quite fit. Infiltrators: blend in and survive without getting caught.

trial.title: The trial
trial.body: After the missions, everyone secretly accuses who they suspect. The most-accused go on trial, and a majority vote ejects them.

win.title: Win the game
win.body: Eject every Infiltrator and the Crew wins. Eject an innocent, and the Infiltrators take the ship.

lobby.codeCopied: ✓ Copied — paste it to your crew
lobby.codeHint: Tap the code to copy · friends join from the main menu
lobby.title: Mission Lobby
lobby.subtitle: Get the crew aboard, then launch

hostSettings.title: Host Settings
hostSettings.customDeckFreeTagline: Write and mix in your own questions.
hostSettings.mixHint: All the sources you turn on are mixed together. Turn off Base Prompts to play mostly your own or the Betrayal Pack.
hostSettings.upgradeHint: The Expansion Pass unlocks 3 & 7-stage games, the Betrayal Pack, and custom decks for your whole table.
hostSettings.keepOneSource: Keep at least one prompt source turned on.
hostSettings.customOnlyMin: Add at least {{min}} custom prompts to play a custom-only game (you have {{count}}).

paywall.title: Expansion Pass
paywall.tagline: Every prompt, plus 3 / 5 / 7-stage games — for you and everyone you host.
paywall.featuresEveryPromptBody: The full question library instead of a small repeating sample.
paywall.featuresBetrayalBody: A whole expansion of juicy, funny friend-group prompts.
paywall.featuresStagesBody: Pick the mission length — quick rounds or long, evidence-rich games.
paywall.featuresCrewBody: Only the host needs it — everyone in your lobby plays the expanded game.
paywall.activeBody: Your whole crew is covered when you host. Thanks for supporting the game!
paywall.lifetimeSub: One-time — yours forever, nothing to cancel.
paywall.monthlySub: Auto-renews monthly — cancel anytime in Settings.
paywall.freeSummary: Free forever: the full base game, 5-stage rounds, and a rotating sample of prompts.
paywall.legal: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase. The monthly plan automatically renews at {{price}} unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple account settings. The lifetime option is a one-time, non-subscription purchase.

premium.title: Expansion Pass
premium.detailFree: Unlock every prompt, pack, and setting
premium.manageSubBody: Open the Settings app → your Apple ID → Subscriptions to change or cancel.
premium.devExpoGo: Expo Go — toggles the Expansion for testing.
premium.footer: Free forever: the full base game, 5-stage rounds, and a rotating sample of prompts. Every prompt, plus 3 / 5 / 7-stage games — for you and everyone you host. Only the host needs the Expansion — it covers everyone in their game. Subscriptions renew monthly until canceled in your Apple account settings; the one-time unlock is permanent.

opinion_hold.label: Opinion Bay
opinion_hold.description: The whole crew enters the bay and takes a stand.

deliberation_deck.label: Decision Deck
deliberation_deck.description: Everyone faces the same scenario — choose your move.

bioscanner.label: Bio Scanner
bioscanner.description: Operators sync glyphs while the captain scans the crew.

drawing_quarters.label: Sketch Bay
drawing_quarters.description: Every crew member draws on the shared sketch bay screens.

writing_pod.label: Fill-in-the-Blank Pod
writing_pod.description: Each player fills in the blank on their own pod terminal.

most_likely_to.label: Likely Locker
most_likely_to.description: The entire locker room votes on who fits the prompt.

game.roleDescAlien: You see different prompts than the crew. Blend in. Tap HACK anytime — the pool is shared with your partner.
game.roleDescHuman: Answer honestly and watch the mission log for answers that do not add up.
game.revealHint:
Make sure nobody is looking at your screen,
then tap to reveal your identity
game.notOnMissionBody: Enter your crew's lobby code on the home screen to rejoin a game in progress.
game.leaveMissionBody: You can rejoin anytime using the same lobby code.
game.captainReadSymbols: Read these symbols aloud to your operators
game.tapMatchingSymbols: Tap symbols that match the captain
game.winCrewEjectedInnocent: The crew ejected an innocent crew member. Infiltrators win.
game.winAllInfiltratorsEjected: Every infiltrator was ejected into space. Crew wins!

packs.betrayalTagline: Juicy friend-group prompts — who would really do you dirty?

repair.glyphLead: Find the one column with all four glyphs. Read it top-down.
repair.frequencyLead: Each glyph's number + the offset (9 wraps to 0).
repair.spectatorCopy: {{operator}} is on the panel; {{engineer}} is reading the schematic. Watch the hull hold.
conduitRules: If there are NO red conduits → sever conduit 2.
Otherwise, if the last conduit is blue and the Reactor ID is odd → sever the first red conduit.
Otherwise, if there are two or more yellow conduits → sever the last yellow conduit.
Otherwise, if the Reactor ID is even → sever the last conduit.

identity.ballotsInScan: {{done}}/{{total}} ballots in — plurality picks the scan target
identity.revoteDesc: The vote split. Pick again — another tie aborts the scan.
identity.nominateDesc: Reactor stable, scanner armed. Vote in secret — most votes gets scanned.
identity.classifiedBody: Only {{captain}} sees whether {{nominee}} is CREW or INFILTRATOR.
identity.scanConfirmInfiltrator: Scan confirms an infiltrator. This intel is captain-only — not logged.
identity.scanConfirmCrew: Scan confirms crew clearance. This intel is captain-only — not logged.
identity.scanRevealHint:
Make sure nobody is looking,
then tap to reveal the scan
identity.debriefDefault: Repairs held. The captain ran the scan — details stay classified.
identity.debriefNoConsensus: No consensus on a scan target. The identity check is skipped.
identity.debriefRepairFailed: Repair failed — scan aborted. No role data was recovered.
identity.debriefScanDone: Scan on {{name}} is complete. Only the captain knows the result.

extraction.ballotsInTrial: {{done}}/{{total}} ballots in — the most-accused go on trial
extraction.voteDescFirst_one: Everyone votes in secret — pick the 1 player you suspect. The most-accused go on trial.
extraction.voteDescFirst_other: Everyone votes in secret — pick the {{count}} players you suspect. The most-accused go on trial.
extraction.voteDescRevote_one: The crew voted to keep the last group. Everyone votes again — pick the 1 player you suspect. The most-accused go on trial.
extraction.voteDescRevote_other: The crew voted to keep the last group. Everyone votes again — pick the {{count}} players you suspect. The most-accused go on trial.
extraction.trialDesc_one: The ballots singled out this player. Majority rules: more ejects than keeps and they go out the airlock. A tie keeps them aboard and triggers a re-vote.
extraction.trialDesc_other: The ballots singled out these players. Majority rules: more ejects than keeps and they go out the airlock. A tie keeps them aboard and triggers a re-vote.
extraction.waitingRest: Waiting for the rest of the crew...

log.title: Mission log
log.subtitle: Every answer from every task
log.noHacksYet: No hacks used yet — tap Hack in the HUD.
log.nothingLoggedDesc: Completed tasks and crew answers will show up here.

hack.title: Neural Hack
hack.subtitle: Shared pool · tap anytime
hack.help: Hack crew → they see infiltrator prompts. Hack yourself → you see crew prompts. Hacks queued mid-task apply when the next task starts.

probe.scrambleDesc: Scramble a crew member's prompts so they see alien tasks instead. Watch the debrief for mistakes. Your partner gets notified.

deck.premiumTitle: Custom decks are a premium feature
deck.premiumBody: The Expansion Pass lets you write your own prompts and mix them into every game you host.
deck.title: Custom Deck
deck.subtitle: Your own questions, mixed into games you host. Toggle it on in the lobby’s Host Settings.
deck.empty: No prompts yet — add your first above.

most_likely_to.label: Most Likely
most_likely_to.crewPlaceholder: Who is most likely to no-show your birthday?
most_likely_to.imposterPlaceholder: Who is most likely to forget what day it is?
most_likely_to.hint: Two similar “who is most likely…” questions. The imposter’s should be answerable the same way — the tell builds over rounds.

writing_pod.label: Fill Blank
writing_pod.hint: Same sentence shape, swapped context. Keep the ___ blank in both.

opinion_hold.label: Opinion
opinion_hold.crewPlaceholder: Leaving a friend on read all day is totally fine.
opinion_hold.imposterPlaceholder: You never owe anyone a fast reply.
opinion_hold.hint: Two agree/disagree statements on the same topic. Both should be defensible out loud.

drawing_quarters.label: Drawing
drawing_quarters.crewPlaceholder: Draw the best gift you’ve ever gotten.
drawing_quarters.imposterPlaceholder: Draw something you’d love to get.
drawing_quarters.hint: Two prompts whose drawings look similar, so a single round never exposes the imposter.

deliberation_deck.label: Scenario
deliberation_deck.crewPlaceholder: A friend asks you to cover for them with a big lie.
deliberation_deck.imposterPlaceholder: A friend asks you for a favor you’re unsure about.
deliberation_deck.hint: Crew see the specific scenario; the imposter sees a vaguer version. Add 2–3 shared answer options.

moderation.reportSubmittedBody: Thanks — we will review this within 24 hours.
moderation.blockBody: They will not be able to join lobbies with you. You can unblock them in Settings.
